meta.name: Install dependencies and verify the environment

context.prd-excerpt:
Project: Link Shelf (slug link-shelf). Project type: greenfield. Project path: C:/Users/Lee/AppData/Local/Temp/oq7-qn0r6zml/poor/app
This is the last task of layer 0 and the gate for everything after it. Every task in layers 3 and 4 depends on it, directly or transitively: they all import fastapi or sqlalchemy, and every one of them runs pytest.
What this task proves, and why each part matters: - The four declared dependencies resolve together. fastapi, sqlalchemy, pytest and httpx have never been resolved as a set before this point, and a version conflict found here is far cheaper than the same conflict found inside L3-002. - The `app` distribution installs. pyproject.toml names the four installed packages explicitly, and setuptools rejects a listed package whose directory does not exist -- so this is the first point in the build where the manifest and the tree on disk are checked against each other. L0-003 could not perform that check, because L0-002's subpackages had not merged yet. - httpx imports. It is the dependency no feature declared, added because starlette's TestClient needs it. If it is missing, every endpoint test from L3-002 onward fails at import rather than on an assertion. - pytest runs. Exit code 5 means "no tests collected", which is the CORRECT result here: layer 0 creates no test modules, and the first real test arrives with L3-002. Treating 5 as a failure would block the layer for doing exactly what it was asked to do.
No external service is needed. SQLite is file-backed and ships with CPython, so there is no database server to start, no container to run, and no port to wait on. Do not add one.
Platform: this project's recorded platform is Windows (win32), so the Windows interpreter path is given first below. The POSIX path is given alongside it so the commands are runnable either way.

task.objective: Create a virtual environment at .venv, install the project and its four declared dependencies into it in editable mode, and prove the environment works: fastapi, sqlalchemy and httpx all import, the `app` package imports from the installed distribution, and pytest runs to completion.

requirements.requirement:
Create a virtual environment in the directory `.venv` at the repository root:
python -m venv .venv
Use the standard library `venv` module. Do not use virtualenv, poetry, pipenv, conda or uv.

Use the environment's own interpreter for every subsequent command in this task. Do NOT rely on shell activation (`activate` / `Activate.ps1`); activation does not survive between separately-invoked commands, and a command that silently falls back to the system interpreter would install the dependencies in the wrong place while still appearing to succeed.
The interpreter path is: Windows: .venv\Scripts\python.exe Linux / macOS: .venv/bin/python
In the commands below this path is written the Windows way, matching this project's recorded platform.

Upgrade pip inside the environment before installing:
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip
Editable installs of a project that has only a pyproject.toml (no setup.py) use PEP 660, which needs pip 21.3 or newer. Upgrading first removes the one failure mode that produces a confusing error about a missing setup.py.

Install the project in editable mode, which pulls in all four declared dependencies:
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e .
Editable, not a plain install: later layers edit app/ constantly, and a non-editable install would leave every task testing a stale copy.

Confirm the three third-party runtime imports succeed together, and report the resolved versions so a later resolver surprise can be diagnosed:
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import fastapi, sqlalchemy, httpx; print(fastapi.__version__, sqlalchemy.__version__, httpx.__version__)"
The command must exit 0. httpx is included deliberately -- it is the dependency no feature declared, and this is the only place before L3-002 where its absence would be caught.

Confirm pytest runs and treat exit code 5 as success:
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q
Accept exit code 0 (tests passed) or 5 (no tests collected). Exit code 5 is the expected result at this point, because layer 0 creates no test modules. Any other exit code -- in particular 4 (usage error, which is what a broken [tool.pytest.ini_options] produces) -- is a failure of this task.

Do NOT create, edit or delete any tracked file. This task installs software; it does not author code.
Specifically: do not add a test module to make pytest exit 0 instead of 5, do not amend pyproject.toml if a dependency fails to resolve, and do not add requirements.txt. If the four declared dependencies genuinely cannot resolve together, that is a finding to report, not a manifest to rewrite -- the manifest is L0-003's output and reflects the PRD's declared stack.
Do not run any git command.
Do NOT start a database server, container, or any background process. SQLite is file-backed and ships with CPython. There is nothing to start and nothing to wait for.

test-requirements.test: Verify the virtual environment exists and its interpreter is present: `python -c "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('.venv/Scripts/python.exe'); q=pathlib.Path('.venv/bin/python'); print('interpreter:', p if p.exists() else q); sys.exit(0 if p.exists() or q.exists() else 1)"` Expected: exit code 0, stdout naming the interpreter path.

Verify the environment's interpreter is Python 3.11 or newer: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys; print(sys.version); sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else 1)"` Expected: exit code 0, stdout showing a 3.11 or newer version string.

Verify the command really ran inside the environment and not against the system interpreter: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys,pathlib; print(sys.prefix); sys.exit(0 if pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).name == '.venv' else 1)"` Expected: exit code 0, stdout ending in `.venv`.

Verify the three third-party dependencies import and report their versions: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import fastapi, sqlalchemy, httpx; print(fastapi.__version__, sqlalchemy.__version__, httpx.__version__)"` Expected: exit code 0. fastapi version 0.110 or greater, sqlalchemy version starting `2.`.

Verify the declared version floors were actually honoured by the resolver, not merely requested: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys,fastapi,sqlalchemy; f=tuple(int(x) for x in fastapi.__version__.split('.')[:2]); print(fastapi.__version__, sqlalchemy.__version__); sys.exit(0 if f >= (0,110) and sqlalchemy.__version__.startswith('2.') else 1)"` Expected: exit code 0.

Verify the project itself installed, and that all four packages named in the setuptools list import from the environment: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import app, app.api, app.models, app.schemas; print('app distribution importable')"` Expected: exit code 0, stdout contains `app distribution importable`.

Verify the install is editable, so later layers' edits to app/ take effect without reinstalling: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys,pathlib,app; here=pathlib.Path('app').resolve(); there=pathlib.Path(app.__file__).parent.resolve(); print(there); sys.exit(0 if here == there else 1)"` Expected: exit code 0, and the printed path is the repository's own app/ directory rather than one inside .venv/Lib/site-packages.

Verify pytest runs to completion, accepting 0 or 5: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q']); print('pytest exit', r.returncode); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode in (0,5) else 1)"` Expected: exit code 0, stdout containing `pytest exit 5` at this point in the build (no test modules exist yet). `pytest exit 0` would also pass.

Verify no tracked file was created or modified by this task -- in particular that no test module was added to force a green pytest run and no requirements file appeared: `python -c "import pathlib,sys; bad=[p.name for p in pathlib.Path('tests').iterdir() if p.name not in ('__init__.py','__pycache__')] + [n for n in ('requirements.txt','requirements-dev.txt','setup.py') if pathlib.Path(n).exists()]; print('unexpected:', bad); sys.exit(0 if not bad else 1)"` Expected: exit code 0, stdout shows `unexpected: []`.

verification.step: Run: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys,pathlib; sys.exit(0 if pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).name == '.venv' and sys.version_info >= (3,11) else 1)"` - must exit 0, confirming a Python 3.11+ environment at .venv (POSIX equivalent interpreter: `.venv/bin/python`)
Run: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import fastapi, sqlalchemy, httpx; print(fastapi.__version__, sqlalchemy.__version__, httpx.__version__)"` - must exit 0 and print three version strings

Run: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys,fastapi,sqlalchemy; f=tuple(int(x) for x in fastapi.__version__.split('.')[:2]); sys.exit(0 if f >= (0,110) and sqlalchemy.__version__.startswith('2.') else 1)"` - must exit 0, confirming the declared floors were honoured
Run: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import app, app.api, app.models, app.schemas; print('app distribution importable')"` - must exit 0 and print `app distribution importable`

Run: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys,pathlib,app; sys.exit(0 if pathlib.Path('app').resolve() == pathlib.Path(app.__file__).parent.resolve() else 1)"` - must exit 0, confirming the install is editable and resolves to the repository's own app/

Run: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q']); print('pytest exit', r.returncode); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode in (0,5) else 1)"` - must exit 0; `pytest exit 5` (no tests collected) is the expected and correct result for layer 0

Run: `python -c "import pathlib,sys; bad=[p.name for p in pathlib.Path('tests').iterdir() if p.name not in ('__init__.py','__pycache__')]; sys.exit(0 if not bad else 1)"` - must exit 0, confirming no test module was added to force a green pytest run
